Climate is the primary determinant of vegetation.

items: Expect questions identifying Taiga as the largest terrestrial biome.
Remember that climate, not soil type alone, is the primary factor determining vegetation.
Note the protective coastal role of mangroves frequently featured in environmental section questions.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Climate serves as the primary determinant for the distribution and type of vegetation.
Taiga holds the record as the world's largest terrestrial biome.
Savanna biomes are uniquely associated with vast populations of migratory herbivores.
Mangrove ecosystems act as essential natural buffers protecting coastlines from destructive storms.
Evergreen forests feature a complex, multi-layered structural canopy, while thorn forests signal arid climatic conditions.
